description_zh: 调用CreateEnsRouteEntry创建自定义路由条目
kebab_example: aliyun ens create-ens-route-entry --route-table-id vtb-bp1cifr72dioje82lse2j --destination-cidr-block 120.XXX.XXX.0/24 --next-hop-id i-5vb7leks9z4mxy1ay258 --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateEnsRouteEntry

parameters.help_en: The ID of the route table to which you want to add a custom route entry
parameters.help_zh: 要创建自定义路由条目的路由表ID
parameters.name: route_table_id

parameters.help_en:
The destination CIDR block of the custom route entry. Make sure that the following requirements are met:

The destination CIDR block cannot point or belong to 100.64.0.0/10.

The destination CIDR blocks of the custom route entries in the same route table cannot overlap.

0.0.0.0/0 indicates the default CIDR block
parameters.help_zh:
自定义路由条目的目标网段。需满足以下要求：
目标网段不能指向100.64.0.0/10或被100.64.0.0/10包含。
同一张路由表内的不同路由条目的目标网段不能相同。
0.0.0.0/0表示默认
parameters.name: destination_cidr_block

parameters.help_en:
The next hop type of the custom route. Valid values:

Instance: an ENS instance.

HaVip: a high-availability virtual IP address (HAVIP).

NetworkPeer: VPC peering connection
parameters.help_zh:
自定义路由条目的下一跳的类型，取值：
Instance（默认值）：ENS实例。
HaVip：高可用虚拟 IP。
NetworkPeer：网络对等连接
parameters.name: next_hop_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the next hop of the custom route entry
parameters.help_zh: 自定义路由条目的下一跳实例的ID
parameters.name: next_hop_id

parameters.help_en: The name of the custom route entry that you want to add. The name must be 1 to 128 characters in length. It cannot start with http\:// or https\://
parameters.help_zh: 要创建的自定义路由条目的名称。长度为1~128个字符，但不能以http://或https://开头
parameters.name: route_entry_name

parameters.help_en: The description of the custom route entry
parameters.help_zh: 自定义路由条目的描述信息
parameters.name: description

parameters.help_en: The source CIDR block is available when you configure a route entry in the gateway route table, but is not unavailable when you configure a route entry in the vSwitch route table
parameters.help_zh: 源地址网段在配置网关路由表的路由条目时可用，但在配置交换机路由表的路由条目时不受支持
parameters.name: source_cidr_block
